headline: Bank of Industry and IFC Sign $50 Million Loan to Support Nigerian MSMEs
summary: Nigeria's Bank of Industry signed a $50 million seven-year loan agreement with the International Finance Corporation to expand long-term financing for manufacturing, agriculture, and renewable energy businesses.
why: Development finance institution loans provide emerging market lenders with foreign currency liquidity and lower funding costs to support small businesses.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Inflow of $50 million in development capital supports domestic MSMEs in manufacturing and agriculture.
